name: clipboard.set
description: Replace the current text contents of the system clipboard. Overwrites whatever is there.

content.description: UTF-8 text to place on the clipboard.

format.description: Only `text` is defined today. Reserved for future formats.

x-implementations.name: open_clipboard_set
x-implementations.description: Win32 `OpenClipboard` + `EmptyClipboard` + `SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT, hMem)` + `CloseClipboard`. Memory handed to the OS via GMEM_MOVEABLE allocation; agent does not free.

windows-modern.description: OpenClipboard + EmptyClipboard + SetClipboardData(CF_UNICODETEXT). Modern apps consume CF_UNICODETEXT directly; the agent does not also publish CF_TEXT (modern apps don't need the ANSI fallback).

windows-classic.description: Same OpenClipboard sequence. Emits BOTH CF_UNICODETEXT and CF_TEXT (transcoded to the active code page) so pre-NT-5 / Win 9x readers can consume the value via the legacy format.
